parameters.query: UPDATE contacts SET nome = COALESCE(NULLIF(($3::jsonb->>'nome'),''), nome), email = COALESCE(NULLIF(($3::jsonb->>'email'),''), email), telefone = COALESCE(NULLIF(($3::jsonb->>'telefone'),''), telefone), attributes = attributes || COALESCE(($3::jsonb->'attributes'), '{}'::jsonb), tags = CASE WHEN $3::jsonb ? 'tags' THEN (SELECT array_agg(DISTINCT x) FROM unnest(tags || ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text($3::jsonb->'tags'))) x) ELSE tags END WHERE id=$1::uuid AND tenant_id=$2::uuid RETURNING id, nome, email, telefone, attributes, tags;
